filesChanged: packages/envoy/internal/broker/oauth/introspect.go: brokerFailure returns the store's own error from beneath the library's wrapper, whose text is only its error code, so the route's 503 is logged with the cause rather than with 'request_unauthorized'. Nothing else in the tree changed this round.
trickyParts: The cause was never lost: the store's error is kept beneath the library's wrapper the whole way. What hid it is that the wrapper's Error() prints its code alone, so returning the wrapper returned a sentence that was true of nothing. Unwrapping it at the one place the broker owns was the whole fix; no store or route change was needed, and the path was checked for a second place a cause is dropped rather than only the last one.
